content: Tailwind CSS v4 with Next.js 15: No tailwind.config.js by default — CSS-first config only. Design tokens defined with @theme in global CSS. @import 'tailwindcss' replaces @tailwind base/components/utilities directives. Content detection is automatic (no content paths needed). PostCSS plugin changed to dedicated plugin. Build speed: ~180ms vs ~1100ms for v3. Breaking: bg-opacity-* and text-opacity-* removed — use slash syntax (bg-blue-500/50). shadcn/ui is compatible with Tailwind v4 as of 2025. Some Radix UI + shadcn dropdown/select components may need fixes after migration.
